incidents.name: unlockSlot payout unbounded by the amount paid
incidents.notes: The unverified contract's unlockSlot(uint256) opens a slot for a 0.6 BNB payment and the follow-up function 0x2dad6442 then pays 10.8 BNB back, so the reward is not bounded by the amount actually paid in.
